episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: With the sudden news of her father's death, Woojoo is forced out of her home.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Best Fair's business secrets are leaked and Woojoo is blamed as the culprit.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Woojoo receives an unexpected offer, and CEO Shin plans to destroy Best Fair.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Best Fair's project is put on hold, and Woojoo has a secret rendezvous.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Woojoo wavers as Dongjin falls apart. Things proceed according to CEO Shin's plans.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Best Fair is driven to the brink. Amidst the chaos, Woojoo and Dongjin are contacted separately.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Jigu is one step closer to finding out Dongjin's identity, and Woojoo fixes her mistakes.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Woojoo asks Dongjin for a favor. Someone begins to question Woojoo's identity.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: CEO Shin tries to win over Woojoo, but Woojoo and Dongjin work as a team.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Jun's concerns deepen, and Dongjin musters up the courage to face Woojoo.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Woojoo tells Hyunju what she has been up to, and someone reveals those secrets to Sunwoo.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: An unwelcome guest visits Dongjin's house. A suspicious man approaches Hyunju with information.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Woo-joo's family finds out Dong-jin's secret. Dong-jin notices a change in Sun-woo's attitude.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Woo-joo prepares to leave and Dong-jin tries to right wrongs, when they both hear shocking news.
